values: Simple pre-launch and regression checklist for QA and manager review
Confirm test URL, environment and latest build
Correct environment and latest build are used
Confirm browser and device test scope
Required browsers and screen sizes are listed
Confirm test accounts and user roles
Valid accounts exist for each role
File loads and uses the correct domain
Check important public pages in sitemap
Main pages included; private and duplicate pages excluded
No broken, redirected or server-error URLs
Required pages and assets are not blocked
Each indexable page has one correct canonical
Check page title on every main page
Unique and relevant title is present
Check meta description on every main page
Unique and relevant description is present
One clear H1 matches the page topic
H2 and H3 headings follow a logical structure
Open Graph title, description and image are correct
Schema is valid and matches visible content
Page loads and content is current
Test Product or Service detail pages
Content, images and enquiry actions work
Address, phone, email, map and form are correct
Test Careers, Blog, News or Resources if present
Listings, pagination and detail pages work
Test Privacy Policy and Terms pages
Pages load from the correct footer links
Menus open and links reach correct pages
All footer links reach correct pages
No broken links, wrong destinations or redirect chains
Logo returns Home and breadcrumbs are correct
Navigation history works without broken states
Submit every form with valid data
Success shown and data reaches correct destination
Submit forms with empty required fields
Enter invalid email, phone and formats
Invalid input is rejected with helpful message
Check min/max length and special characters
Check consent checkbox and policy links
Check CAPTCHA or spam protection if present
Test all primary and secondary buttons
Correct page, modal or action opens
Test menus, tabs, accordions, sliders and carousels
Test search, filters, sorting and pagination
Results and empty states are correct
Open, close, Esc and outside-click work
No broken images or missing placeholders
Check image quality, crop and ratio
Images are sharp and not stretched
Meaningful images have useful alt text
Test video, audio, downloads and documents
Media plays and files open or download
Check alignment, spacing, fonts and colors
Test desktop, tablet and mobile widths
No scrolling, overlap, clipping or hidden content
Check hover, focus, active and disabled states
Navigate key journeys using keyboard only
Logical tab order and visible focus
Test required Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari
Check page loading and interaction speed
Check optimized images and lazy loading
Confirm HTTPS and no mixed content
All pages and assets are secure
Check sensitive data is not exposed
No passwords, tokens or private data in URLs or logs
Choices save and tracking respects consent
Page views and key events fire once
Check form, CTA, download and outbound events
Clear loading and error states appear
Test long text, missing images and empty content
Layout remains stable with clear fallbacks
Check spelling, contact details and legal text
Published content is accurate and approved
Check dates, prices, units and currencies
Values are current and correctly formatted
Check console and network errors on key journeys
No significant errors or failed requests
Fixes work and critical features remain working
Sign-off, open issues and release decision documented
